answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. The inspector keeps the 121 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 496 proofs drain 60016 POA from the farm and give nothing back. A jade from a stranger, a zenith from a ledger, a nadir from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Falconry steward lanner proof flown at the hawking ground, the mark is each lanner is a year of mews logs in the falconry ledger, and the panel accepts nothing else.
